BUT deriveThemingNote(shimmer) returns 'Themed via text-muted.' while packages/registry/src/components/ai/shimmer.tsx:23,63 uses 'text-muted-foreground'. TOKEN_CLASS at scripts/docs-data/theming-note.ts:23-24 alternation lists 'muted' before 'muted-foreground' (and card/popover/primary/secondary/accent/destructive before their -foreground compounds), so every compound token is captured truncated. text-muted and text-muted-foreground are different utilities over different tokens — the note names a class the source does not use, systematically, across the 39 items. This mislabeled data flows into FUSE-05's dataset and onto 39 rendered item pages.
